concerns.text: FR-004a and FR-004b are two separate MUSTs (train Linear Regression with CV AND train RandomForest with CV), but T108 trains only ONE model selected by the FR-010 linearity verdict ('selects Linear Regression ... or RandomForest'). If the verdict is linear, no task trains/evaluates the RandomForest model, leaving FR-004b uncovered. Add a task (or extend T108) that trains the RandomForest under the same GroupKFold CV regardless of the linearity verdict, or note the spec's US-2 'or' reading explicitly.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs spec.md:US-1 acceptance scenario 1
concerns.text: US-1 scenario 1 requires the download to complete 'within 30 minutes of wall-clock time', but no task records or verifies download wall-clock time. T111 checks only the ≤6 h total budget. Add download-duration recording/assertion to T102 or T106.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T103 vs plan.md Phase 3 / data-model.md ClusteringDescriptor
concerns.text: T103 computes descriptors 'from the pre-insertion cluster geometry', while the plan's Phase 3 and data-model.md both mandate descriptors computed 'after EAM relaxation, only within the interface mask'. The task covers FR-002 but implements the OPPOSITE pipeline from the plan element it claims to implement; the plan/data-model/contract descriptions were never reconciled, so an implementer cannot satisfy both. Reconcile (amend plan Phase 3, data-model.md, and dataset.schema.yaml descriptions, or revert T103) so the covered methodology is unambiguous.

FR-012 scopes VIF to 'the original three descriptors', while T107 says VIF is computed on 'the raw descriptors' without stating whether that is the 3 FR-002 descriptors or all 7 predictors used in the power analysis. T107 covers FR-012 only ambiguously; state the exact feature set (and if 7, note the FR-012 deviation).
